---
title: "My Teaching Philosophy"
---

"The mediocre teacher tells…



The good teacher explains…



The superior teacher demonstrates…



The great teacher inspires!"



— **William Arthur Ward**



\* Foster [**critical thinking, professional judgment, and problem-solving skills**]{style="color: orange;"} through engaging accounting education.



\* Promote [**active, experiential, and real-world learning**]{style="color: orange;"} by connecting accounting concepts to contemporary business issues.



\* Use bottom-up learning approach to link [**fundamental accounting principles to broader organizational and industry-level challenges**]{style="color: orange;"}.



\* Integrate [**current accounting research, case studies, emerging technologies, and professional practices**]{style="color: orange;"} to enrich classroom learning.
